run_id: unique run UUID; condition/config association is in manifest.json

metric_definitions.post_5s_afr_rmse: AFR RMSE over [5 s,end]; final sample if shorter than 5 s
metric_definitions.final_window_mean_rpm: Mean RPM over last simulated second including endpoints
metric_definitions.final_window_mean_afr: Mean AFR over last simulated second including endpoints
metric_definitions.rpm_settling_time_s: Time after final input change satisfying stored band with at least 1 s confirmation; null if not observed
metric_definitions.sampled_fuel_used_g: Trapezoidal integration of reported model fuel mass flow
metric_definitions.sensitivity_ranges: Min/max over tested deterministic cases; not confidence intervals
